I'm an undergraduate senior studying computer science at [Cornell](https://www.cornell.edu/). I'm interested in the theory of computing, logic, and programming language theory.

Outside of CS, I enjoy playing bass guitar, skateboarding, playing [Bethesda games](https://bethesda.net/en/games), and watching New York sports.

Some other stuff I'm up to:

- Head TA for [CS 3110](https://www.cs.cornell.edu/courses/cs3110/).
- Working with [Dexter Kozen](https://www.cs.cornell.edu/~kozen/) to add tests to probabilistic multiset semantics.
- Occasionally contributing to [raig](https://github.com/cucapra/raig).
